test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I wonder if the postman _____ today.
solution: The correct answer is **'will come'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate option for the given blank is** 'will come'.** • The given sentence is an example of the **first conditional.** • The structure of these kinds of sentences is: • If+Present Indefinite, Simple Future​ • Example:* If he works hard, he will surely get the job.* • Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.** **Correct Sentence:__** *I wonder if the postman **will come** today.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__** __ • An **if-** or **when-clause** generally does not contain “will"__, which is the simple future tense of the verb “to be.” [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] __Confusion Points__ __ • **Exception 1: **When the action in the if- or when-clause__ **takes place after that in the main clause. ** • Example:* If paracetamol **will **ease my fever, I **will **take one tonight instead of this medicine.* __ • Exception 2: When “will” is not being used as a helping verb but as a modal verb or we can say “will” is used in the if- clause__ when **it is being used to politely express willingness, persistence, or a wish**. • Example:* I think I **will **warm some water for tea if you **will **excuse me.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] __Hinglish__ • दिए गए रिक्त स्थान के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प **'will come' **है। • दिया गया वाक्य **first conditional **का उदाहरण है। • इस प्रकार के वाक्यों की संरचना है: • If+Present Indefinite, Simple Future​ • Example:* If he works hard, he will surely get the job.* • अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 3 **है। 31:T9a9, The correct answer is '**Hoot**'.
